## What's changed

- Added `--bare` flag for scripted `-p` calls — skips hooks, LSP, plugin sync, and skill directory walks; requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an `apiKeyHelper` via `--settings` (OAuth and keychain auth disabled); auto-memory fully disabled
- Added `--channels` permission relay — channel servers that declare the permission capability can forward tool approval prompts to your phone
- Fixed multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions requiring repeated re-authentication when one session refreshes its OAuth token
- Fixed voice mode silently swallowing retry failures and showing a misleading "check your network" message instead of the actual error
- Fixed voice mode audio not recovering when the server silently drops the WebSocket connection
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` not suppressing the structured-outputs beta header, causing 400 errors on proxy gateways forwarding to Vertex/Bedrock
- Fixed `--channels` bypass for Team/Enterprise orgs with no other managed settings configured
- Fixed a crash on Node.js 18
- Fixed unnecessary permission prompts for Bash commands containing dashes in strings
- Fixed plugin hooks blocking prompt submission when the plugin directory is deleted mid-session
- Fixed a race condition where background agent task output could hang indefinitely when the task completed between polling intervals
- Resuming a session that was in a worktree now switches back to that worktree
- Fixed `/btw` not including pasted text when used during an active response
- Fixed a race where fast Cmd+Tab followed by paste could beat the clipboard copy under tmux
- Fixed terminal tab title not updating with an auto-generated session description
- Fixed invisible hook attachments inflating the message count in transcript mode
- Fixed Remote Control sessions showing a generic title instead of deriving from the first prompt
- Fixed `/rename` not syncing the title for Remote Control sessions
- Fixed Remote Control `/exit` not reliably archiving the session
- Improved MCP read/search tool calls to collapse into a single "Queried {server}" line (expand with Ctrl+O)
- Improved `!` bash mode discoverability — Claude now suggests it when you need to run an interactive command
- Improved plugin freshness — ref-tracked plugins now re-clone on every load to pick up upstream changes
- Improved Remote Control session titles to refresh after your third message
- Updated MCP OAuth to support Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD / SEP-991) for servers without Dynamic Client Registration
- Changed plan mode to hide the "clear context" option by default (restore with `"showClearContextOnPlanAccept": true`)
- Disabled line-by-line response streaming on Windows (including WSL in Windows Terminal) due to rendering issues
- [VSCode] Fixed Windows PATH inheritance for Bash tool when using Git Bash (regression in v2.1.78)

key_changes: 新增 --bare 标志用于脚本化调用，跳过钩子、LSP、插件同步等，适用于自动化场景
新增 --channels 权限转发功能，支持将工具审批提示转发到手机
修复 OAuth Token 刷新导致多会话重复认证的问题
修复语音模式的多个问题（重试失败、WebSocket 连接断开恢复）
修复 Node.js 18 上的崩溃问题以及多个 UI/交互相关缺陷
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次更新新增了 --bare 标志用于脚本化自动化调用，以及 --channels 权限转发功能支持移动端审批。同时修复了 OAuth 多会话认证、语音模式稳定性、Node.js 18 兼容性等十余个问题，显著提升了工具的稳定性和可用性。

-   6daad22: ### Bug Fixes

    -   **XPath selector support** - Fixed element resolution to correctly handle the `xpath=` selector prefix (#908)

    ### Performance

    -   **Fast-path for identical snapshots** - Short-circuits the Myers diff algorithm when comparing a snapshot to itself, avoiding unnecessary computation in retry and loop workloads where repeated identical snapshots are common (#922)

    -   Migrated page metadata from MDX files to `layout.tsx` (#904)
    -   Added search functionality and color improvements to docs (#927)
    -   Fixed desktop browser list in the iOS comparison table (#926)

issue_insights.summary_brief: 跨仓库共性问题集中在三大类：workflow_runtime（任务执行失败/模型兼容性）影响17个仓库、auth_permission（认证授权）涉及6个仓库、tool_call_protocol（工具调用协议）涉及6个仓库，其中P0级问题占比超40%。高影响单仓问题突出表现在OpenDevin自托管V1架构变更导致部署完全不可用、agno存在多个RCE安全漏洞、claude-code-action输出丢失致生产工作流中断。
global_highlights: 【workflow_runtime】任务执行故障广泛存在：AutoGPT多类Block抛BlockUnknownError、agentscope的Qwen3.x模型兼容性问题、OpenDevin自托管V1在READY状态后事件持久化失败致Agent卡死、claude-code-action完成审查但不生成评论输出
【auth_permission】认证授权缺陷频发：agno的CodingTools存在解释器标志注入RCE和换行符绕过漏洞、claude-code-action默认工作流模板在公开仓库泄露secrets、Bedrock OIDC认证自v1.0.74起中断、Bitbucket x-token-auth格式在TabbyML/tabby不被支持
【tool_call_protocol】工具调用协议不一致：gptme工具描述超1024字符被截断、anthropic-sdk-python流式工具使用时JSON解析错误无上下文、claude-agent-sdk-python与CLI协议不匹配致子Agent结果丢失、claude-code MCP频道通知无法送达会话
【startup_crash/packaging_release】启动崩溃/打包缺陷：Auto-Claude beta.5缺失npm包致跨平台启动崩溃、opencode在插件auth hook返回空数组或Bun打包命名空间重导出时崩溃、claude-code-action OIDC令牌交换500错误持续7小时

top_pain_points.topic: Task execution failures during planned operations
top_pain_points.summary: Users report task execution failures when hitting play with simple prompts, showing error dialogs that prevent completion
top_pain_points.review_reason: Core workflow functionality (task execution) is failing for users. While only 1 issue reported, it affects the main use case of the application - executing planned tasks.

source_issues.title: Failed planned
source_issues.evidence: User reports continuous errors when hitting play with simple prompt, tasks fail to complete

source_issues.title: bug: typescript client for experiments fails to attach / detach the global tracer
source_issues.evidence: The problem right now is that the global tracer cannot be unmounted properly. This might be due to it being an anti-pattern in OTEL. however we need to find a way to unmount it and setup a new tracer so that the traces land on two different projects.

source_issues.title: fix: auto-select search backend with fallbacks, hide unavailable engines
source_issues.evidence: DuckDuckGo search is disabled due to bot detection, agents try DDG first, get an error, then retry with Perplexity - wasted steps

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: conversation reaches READY and first LLM completion succeeds, but no assistant or action events are persisted
source_issues.evidence: Observed: sandbox starts, repo preparation completes, conversation reaches READY, first LLM completion succeeds, but event stream contains only startup events and user message - no assistant/action/observation events follow. Conversation stays in RUNNING.

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: repository is cloned into a subdirectory while setup and hook logic assume repo root at workspace root
source_issues.evidence: Observed: repo cloned to /workspace/project/<repo-name> but setup logic looks for .openhands/ at /workspace/project. Breaks setup.sh discovery, hook discovery, git cwd incorrect.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: OHEditor view command fails on valid UTF-8 markdown files with dense CJK characters
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible with valid UTF-8 .md files containing ~1KB+ of Chinese text. binaryornot.check.is_binary() returns True incorrectly. Blocks view command for CJK users.

source_issues.title: User-level Skills from personal .agents repositories not loading in OpenHands Cloud
source_issues.evidence: User created personal .agents repo with skill file, selected repo owned by that user, skill does not load. Same skill format works at repo-level. Documentation promises this feature.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by ReplicateFluxAdvancedModelBlock with message: Error generating image
source_issues.evidence: Image generation block throws BlockUnknownError with message 'Error generating image', blocking user workflows that require AI-generated images

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by CreateTalkingAvatarVideoBlock with message: HTTP 403 Error: Forbidden
source_issues.evidence: Video creation block fails with HTTP 403 permission error for subtitles, preventing users from creating avatar videos

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by ExaSearchBlock with message: Unknown error occurred
source_issues.evidence: Search block throws unknown error, causing web search functionality to fail in agent workflows

top_pain_points.topic: Bitbucket repository connection fails with token-based authentication (x-token-auth format)
top_pain_points.summary: Users cannot connect Bitbucket repositories as source context when using the x-token-auth:token@bitbucket.org URL format for authentication. The clone operation fails even though the same URL works with standard git command line.
top_pain_points.review_reason: Blocks a core feature (adding repository context) for users with private Bitbucket repositories. The authentication method that works in standard git fails in Tabby's integrated client, causing complete feature failure for this use case.

source_issues.title: Unable to connect to bitbucket repo
source_issues.evidence: User reports failed clone operation with error: 'Failed to clone repository' when using Bitbucket's x-token-auth URL format. The feature is completely blocked for private Bitbucket repos requiring token auth.

source_issues.title: RCE via interpreter flag injection in _check_command
source_issues.evidence: CVSS 9.8 Critical vulnerability. The allowlist bypass permits arbitrary code execution via interpreter inline-execution flags. User demonstrates that python -c with arbitrary code passes all checks in restricted mode.

source_issues.title: run_shell _check_command can be bypassed with newline in command
source_issues.evidence: User reports that _check_command blocks &&, ||, ;, | but not newline characters. Passing 'ls\nrm -rf /' bypasses all checks. Since run_shell takes LLM output, this is reachable if the model generates commands with embedded newlines.

source_issues.title: Cloudflare Workers AI not working
source_issues.evidence: Test with workers ai model returns 'Could not route to /client/v4/accounts/...' - Not Found error

source_issues.title: A previously removed provider 'Model Studio Coding Plan' keeps reappearing in new sessions
source_issues.evidence: Removed provider keeps reappearing, cannot be removed via UI (Disconnect does nothing), provider is unusable

source_issues.title: Invalid Argument errors when using Vertex with `google-github-actions/auth`
source_issues.evidence: User provides specific error output showing 400 Invalid Argument when calling Vertex AI through the SDK with GitHub Actions auth. Works locally but fails in CI, blocking main workflow for CI/CD users.

source_issues.title: Allow limiting tools that are exposed to the main agent
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states: 'I want to block usage of these tools by the main agent but have them working on the sub-agents.' Currently no mechanism exists to achieve this separation of tool visibility.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials are present, but Claude Code fails with 'API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers'. Was working before v1.0.74.

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: Same credentials/endpoint work with @anthropic-ai/sdk but claude-code-action returns 403. Agent SDK's internal HTTP client appears to make API calls differently.

source_issues.title: Default workflow template missing author trust gate — secrets exposed on public repos
source_issues.evidence: Template only checks for @claude mention, not author_association. Any user can trigger workflow that accesses secrets and OIDC tokens. Security docs claim 'only users with write access' but workflow starts regardless.

source_issues.evidence: Production impact confirmed: pydantic-ai's FallbackModel checks status_code >= 500 to decide whether to try the next model. The overloaded error had status_code=200, so fallback never fired.

source_issues.title: Claude says that I send an empty message but I didn't

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK

source_issues.title: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug corrupts SDK protocol - debug logs should go to stderr
source_issues.evidence: Setting ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug breaks SDK with 'CLI output was not valid JSON' error. Debug logs written to stdout corrupt the parent-child JSON protocol communication.

top_pain_points.topic: Self-hosted V1 WebSocket endpoint architecture breaks deployment connectivity
top_pain_points.summary: V1 removed the single endpoint (port 3000) that handled all WebSocket connections for sandboxes. Now browsers must connect directly to each sandbox's WebSocket endpoint, exposing non-standard ports that may be blocked by ISPs and requiring complex dynamic firewall/proxy configurations. This completely breaks self-hosted deployments.
top_pain_points.review_reason: High severity - completely breaks self-hosted deployments by requiring browser-to-sandbox direct connections that don't work in typical network configurations. User explicitly states 'completely breaks self-hosted deployments'.

source_issues.title: Reintroduce single endpoint for handling all WebSocket connections across sandboxes
source_issues.evidence: User reports: V1 endpoint no longer supports WebSockets, browser must connect directly to sandbox WebSocket endpoints exposed as localhost:(port), non-standard ports blocked by ISPs, increases complexity of firewall and reverse proxy configurations.

source_issues.title: CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates that CustomEvent fields are lost after Redis round-trip. Events are stored as empty shells with no payload. This affects documented patterns where tools yield CustomEvent for frontend consumption.

source_issues.title: CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization (asdict)
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report of same issue with technical root cause analysis. dataclasses.asdict() only serializes declared fields, not dynamically set instance attributes.

signals.topic: CodingTools shell command security bypass vulnerabilities

Since run_shell accepts LLM output, these are exploitable attack vectors.
signals.review_reason: Two independent security vulnerabilities allow bypassing sandbox restrictions in CodingTools, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution. Both are user-reported issues with clear exploitation paths through LLM-generated commands.

source_issues.title: RCE via interpreter flag injection in _check_command

source_issues.title: run_shell _check_command can be bypassed with newline in command

signals.topic: Vertex AI authentication fails with GitHub Actions federated auth
signals.summary: Users attempting to use the SDK with Vertex AI via GitHub Actions federated authentication (Workload Identity Federation) encounter 'Invalid Argument' errors (400 status). The authentication works locally but fails in the CI/CD environment, blocking automated testing workflows.
signals.review_reason: This is a workflow-blocking issue where users cannot use the SDK in their CI/CD pipelines with Vertex AI and GitHub Actions federated auth. Has concrete error output and reproduction steps, blocking automated testing workflows.

source_issues.title: Invalid Argument errors when using Vertex with `google-github-actions/auth`
source_issues.evidence: User provides specific error output showing 400 Invalid Argument when calling Vertex AI through the SDK with GitHub Actions auth. Works locally but fails in CI, blocking main workflow for CI/CD users.

signals.topic: Streaming tool use emits unhelpful JSON parsing error messages
signals.summary: When using client.messages.stream() with tools, if the model emits malformed JSON during input_json_delta, users receive raw internal parser errors like 'ValueError: expected ident at line 1 column 11' with no context about what happened or guidance on how to resolve it
signals.review_reason: Valid user pain point: all users of client.messages.stream() with tool calling are affected. When triggered, error provides no context about the source of the problem (tool JSON parsing) or actionable guidance. Beta path already has a helpful error message, non-beta path is simply missing the same try-except wrapper.

source_issues.title: Streaming tool use: unhelpful error message when model emits malformed JSON (non-beta path missing try-except)
source_issues.evidence: User receives raw jiter error 'ValueError: expected ident' with no indication the error came from tool input JSON parsing, no mention of what JSON was received, and no guidance. It looks like an SDK crash.

signals.topic: Mid-stream SSE errors report incorrect HTTP status codes
signals.summary: When the API returns HTTP 200 (streaming started) but then sends an SSE error event like overloaded_error, the SDK creates an APIStatusError with status_code=200 instead of the actual error code (e.g., 529). This breaks retry/fallback logic that relies on status code checking.
signals.review_reason: Valid user pain point with production impact evidence. Callers checking status_code for retry/fallback decisions get the wrong answer. An overloaded_error should look like a 529, not a 200. User confirmed this broke their production FallbackModel logic.

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get status_code=200 instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: Production impact confirmed: pydantic-ai's FallbackModel checks status_code >= 500 to decide whether to try the next model. The overloaded error had status_code=200, so fallback never fired.

signals.topic: toBase64 utility crashes with stack overflow on large files in non-Node environments
signals.summary: The toBase64 utility function in the SDK crashes with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' error when processing inputs larger than ~100KB in environments without Node.js Buffer support (browsers, Cloudflare Workers, etc.). This breaks image upload functionality and other operations requiring base64 encoding of large binary data.
signals.review_reason: This is a genuine user pain point: the SDK's toBase64 function crashes deterministically when encoding large files (>100KB) in browser and edge runtime environments, completely blocking image upload workflows. Users in non-Node environments cannot use the SDK for vision/image features. Issue is open and actively discussed (2 comments). Marked P1 (not P0) because count=1 and affects only one repository, but the impact on affected users is significant - complete workflow failure for image operations.

source_issues.title: toBase64  stack overflow on large inputs (e.g. image uploads) in non-Node environments
source_issues.evidence: User reports crash with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' error when calling toBase64 on inputs > 100KB in browser/Cloudflare Workers. Provides reproduction code: const large = new Uint8Array(200 * 1024); toBase64(large); // Crashes with RangeError

signals.topic: SDK-CLI Protocol Communication Failures (subagent results lost, parse errors, callbacks broken)
signals.summary: Multiple protocol-level issues where the SDK's expectations don't match CLI behavior: sub-agent results not being used by main agent, structured_output missing from ResultMessage, MessageParseError on rate_limit_event, and can_use_tool permission callbacks never firing despite proper setup.
signals.review_reason: Multiple users report critical workflow failures: subagent results lost causing empty message errors, structured output missing breaking API contracts, parser crashes on every query for Max subscription users, and permission system completely non-functional. These are blocking issues affecting core SDK functionality across multiple features.

source_issues.title: Claude says that I send an empty message but I didn't
source_issues.evidence: User reports sub-agent completed and returned information, but main agent didn't use it, resulting in 'empty message' error. TaskNotificationMessage arrives before ToolResultBlock, suggesting protocol timing issue.

source_issues.title: structured_output not present in the ResultMessage block if certain tool calls happen after StructuredOutput block
source_issues.evidence: Background subagent finishes after StructuredOutput block appears, and structured_output is missing from ResultMessage - breaking structured output feature.

source_issues.title: MessageParseError on rate_limit_event from CLI (v0.0.25)
source_issues.evidence: Every query fails with MessageParseError when CLI emits rate_limit_event (happens on every query with Max subscription/OAuth). Parser raises on unrecognized message type.

source_issues.title: [BUG] mismatch between the Claude CLI control protocol and can_use_tool permission
source_issues.evidence: can_use_tool control callbacks are never emitted by CLI 2.1.6 despite --permission-prompt-tool stdio being set. SDK permission hooks cannot fire, blocking tool permission enforcement.

signals.topic: Bedrock and Third-party Provider Incompatibility
signals.summary: SDK features that work with Anthropic API fail on AWS Bedrock and other Anthropic-compatible providers: eager_input_streaming causes hard errors on Bedrock, and thinking=disabled configuration is not preserved for third-party backends.
signals.review_reason: Users deploying on AWS Bedrock or third-party Anthropic-compatible providers experience hard failures or unexpected behavior. This blocks enterprise users who cannot use direct Anthropic API and must route through Bedrock or other providers.

source_issues.title: eager_input_streaming breaks Bedrock deployments: 'Extra inputs are not permitted'
source_issues.evidence: After SDK v0.1.48, include_partial_messages=True causes immediate error on Bedrock: 'tools.0.custom.eager_input_streaming: Extra inputs are not permitted'. Bedrock performs strict schema validation and rejects unknown fields.

source_issues.title: [Bug] SDK maps thinking={"type":"disabled"} to --max-thinking-tokens 0, which breaks Anthropic-compatible providers
source_issues.evidence: Users cannot reliably disable thinking through SDK when targeting third-party backends. SDK downgrades thinking={'type':'disabled'} to CLI flag --max-thinking-tokens 0, which is not equivalent for providers that distinguish between omitted and explicit disabled thinking.

signals.topic: SDK MCP Server Tool Calls Fail with 'Stream closed' After ~70 Seconds
signals.summary: Custom MCP tools registered via create_sdk_mcp_server start failing with 'Stream closed' error after approximately 60-70 seconds of operation, while built-in tools continue working. The bundled CLI doesn't reset lastActivityTime when MCP server responses arrive.
signals.review_reason: Critical bug that completely breaks custom MCP tool usage for any workflow lasting more than 60-70 seconds. This is a hard failure that makes SDK MCP servers unusable for realistic workloads, forcing users to find workarounds or abandon the feature.

source_issues.title: [BUG] SDK MCP server tool calls fail with 'Stream closed' after ~70s - Python SDK v0.1.47
source_issues.evidence: Tool calls return 'Stream closed' error within 1-5ms - the tool never gets a chance to execute. Built-in tools (Read, Grep) work fine during same session. Root cause: CLI doesn't reset lastActivityTime when MCP responses arrive.

signals.topic: SDK Fails Silently in Docker Environment with DEBUG Environment Variable
signals.summary: Python SDK subprocess runs successfully but the SDK process receives no messages and silently finishes when DEBUG env var is set to any value in Docker environment. Works fine without DEBUG or on macOS regardless of DEBUG.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users running SDK in containerized environments (common for CI/CD and production deployments) if they have DEBUG set for any reason. Silent failure mode is particularly problematic as it provides no error message for debugging.

source_issues.title: Python SDK is broken in Docker environment with DEBUG env var and Claude Code 2.0.43+
source_issues.evidence: Claude Code subprocess runs successfully (prints sandbox debug message), but Python process does not receive any message from iterator and just silently finishes. Issue persists across multiple SDK/CLI versions since Claude Code 2.0.43.

signals.topic: Tool Visibility Control Limitations for Sub-agents
signals.summary: Users cannot expose tools to sub-agents without also exposing them to the main agent. Adding tools to allowed_tools makes them available to both, but removing them breaks sub-agent tool access. No way to differentiate tool permissions between main agent and sub-agents.
signals.review_reason: Limits architectural flexibility for multi-agent systems where sub-agents should have specialized tool access that the orchestrating agent shouldn't use directly. Not a blocking issue but significantly impacts ability to design proper agent hierarchies.

source_issues.title: Allow limiting tools that are exposed to the main agent
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states: 'I want to block usage of these tools by the main agent but have them working on the sub-agents.' Currently no mechanism exists to achieve this separation of tool visibility.

signals.topic: SDK debugging and error handling issues
signals.summary: Multiple issues affect SDK debugging capabilities: (1) Error messages are vague and contradictory (subtype:'error_during_execution' but is_error:false, empty errors array). (2) ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug breaks the SDK by corrupting JSON protocol with debug logs written to stdout instead of stderr.
signals.review_reason: These issues directly impact developers' ability to debug and handle errors in SDK-based applications. Unclear error messages prevent proper error handling, and broken debug logging prevents diagnosing API issues (auth failures, rate limits). Both are clearly user-blocking issues with reproduction steps.

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK
source_issues.evidence: User showed actual error response with contradictory fields (subtype:'error_during_execution' but is_error:false) and empty errors array. Cannot show meaningful errors to end users.

source_issues.title: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug corrupts SDK protocol - debug logs should go to stderr
source_issues.evidence: Setting ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug breaks SDK with 'CLI output was not valid JSON' error. Debug logs written to stdout corrupt the parent-child JSON protocol communication.

signals.topic: Sandbox silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when dependencies missing
signals.summary: When sandbox.enabled=true is set but bwrap/socat dependencies are missing, the SDK silently falls back to completely unsandboxed execution without any error or warning. Users get a false sense of security as all sandbox configuration (filesystem, network restrictions) is silently ignored.
signals.review_reason: Security-critical issue where explicit security configuration is silently ignored. Users who enable sandboxing expect it to be enforced or fail loudly, not to be silently bypassed. This creates a false sense of security and could lead to unintended data exposure or malicious command execution.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly configured sandbox.enabled: true with network/filesystem restrictions, but Bash commands ran with full filesystem and network access. No error or warning emitted in query() result stream.

signals.topic: Custom systemPrompt ignored by agent starting from v0.2.15+
signals.summary: A regression introduced in v0.2.15 causes custom systemPrompt to be effectively ignored. The agent reverts to behaving as a generic Claude assistant regardless of custom role/behavior instructions, breaking applications that rely on custom agent behaviors.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality regression that breaks applications relying on custom agent behaviors. Users building custom AI workflows with specific roles/languages cannot upgrade past v0.2.14. Clear reproduction steps and root cause analysis provided.

source_issues.title: Custom `systemPrompt` string ignored by agent in v0.2.15+ — agent does not follow custom role/behavior instructions
source_issues.evidence: User confirmed through proxy inspection that custom prompt is present in system message but agent ignores it. Version testing shows it works in v0.2.14 but broken from v0.2.15 onwards. User had to lock to v0.2.14 as workaround.

signals.topic: File checkpointing not working in SDK (non-interactive) mode
signals.summary: Despite enableFileCheckpointing:true being set, file checkpointing snapshots are never created when using the SDK programmatically. rewindFiles() always returns 'No file checkpoint found' because snapshot creation is only implemented in interactive UI code paths.
signals.review_reason: Feature explicitly enabled by user but doesn't work in SDK mode. Users expect file checkpointing to work when they set enableFileCheckpointing:true, but it silently fails. Clear root cause analysis provided showing the implementation gap between interactive and SDK modes.

source_issues.title: File checkpointing snapshots not created in SDK (non-interactive) mode
source_issues.evidence: User enabled enableFileCheckpointing:true and confirmed CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING env var is set correctly, but rewindFiles() always fails. Root cause identified: snapshot creation function only called in React/Ink interactive UI code paths, never in SDK mode.

signals.topic: PR/Issue review comments not posted despite successful execution
signals.summary: Claude completes code reviews (consuming tokens, running tools) but the action produces no visible GitHub comment. Logs show 'No buffered inline comments' and no PR/issue comment is posted. Affects multiple trigger types and plugins.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality failure: users spend API credits and wait for reviews that never appear. Multiple independent reports confirm the issue across different trigger types (issue_comment, pull_request) and plugins. Blocks the primary use case of automated PR reviews.

source_issues.title: Claude doesn't generate any output from PR review
source_issues.evidence: User reports Claude runs for several minutes but produces no comment or report. Screenshots show workflow completes with no output.

source_issues.title: claude-code-action silently drops output comments on issue_comment triggers
source_issues.evidence: Claude uses ~350k input tokens and generates ~4800 output tokens, but logs show 'No buffered inline comments' and no PR comment is posted.

source_issues.title: PR-triggered workflows produce no visible output when Claude has no inline diff comments
source_issues.evidence: When Claude's analysis has no line-specific feedback, nothing gets posted to the PR at all. Action logs show 'No buffered inline comments'.

source_issues.title: code-review plugin completes review but produces empty result — no PR comment posted
source_issues.evidence: Plugin runs for ~7 minutes, completes successfully (24 turns), but session ends with empty result so no comment is ever posted.

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase fails or hangs indefinitely
signals.summary: The config restore feature introduced in v1.0.74 causes workflows to fail or hang: (1) fails on repos with non-'main' default branch due to hardcoded 'main' fallback, (2) hangs indefinitely (~4 hours reported) on repos with .gitmodules/submodules.
signals.review_reason: Workflow-blocking issue: causes complete workflow failure (non-main branch) or indefinite hang consuming runner minutes (submodules). Both scenarios block all downstream Claude execution. Affects any repo not using 'main' as default or using submodules.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: Action fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' when repo uses 'master' as default branch. Multiple code locations hardcode 'main' as fallback.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: On issue_comment events, restoreConfigFromBase attempts to fetch 'origin/main' regardless of actual default branch, causing failure.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with .gitmodules (submodules)
source_issues.evidence: In repos with .gitmodules, the restore step hangs indefinitely with no output. Job ran for ~4 hours until manually cancelled.

signals.topic: Authentication failures with Bedrock and custom API endpoints
signals.summary: Users experience 403/authentication errors when using AWS Bedrock or custom base URLs (LiteLLM proxy): (1) Bedrock OIDC auth broken since v1.0.74, (2) LiteLLM proxy returns 403 despite working with standard Anthropic SDK.
signals.review_reason: Blocks workflows for users with specific auth providers. Bedrock users with valid OIDC credentials cannot use the action at all. Custom proxy users (enterprise scenarios) are similarly blocked. Both represent common enterprise deployment patterns.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials are present, but Claude Code fails with 'API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers'. Was working before v1.0.74.

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: Same credentials/endpoint work with @anthropic-ai/sdk but claude-code-action returns 403. Agent SDK's internal HTTP client appears to make API calls differently.

signals.topic: OIDC token exchange and installation failures
signals.summary: Service-side issues causing complete workflow failure: (1) OIDC token exchange returns 500 errors for 7+ hours, (2) Claude Code v2.1.79 binary download returns 403 from install.sh CDN.
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow failure at startup phase. These issues block ALL users (OAuth token users for #1079, all @v1 users for #1091) before Claude even runs. #1091 was closed but represents a pattern of installation fragility.

source_issues.title: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error since Mar 18 12:00 UTC
source_issues.evidence: All workflows using claude_code_oauth_token fail with 500 error. Issue persisted 7+ hours with multiple failed run examples provided.

source_issues.title: v1 action fails to install Claude Code v2.1.79 (403 from install.sh)
source_issues.evidence: Action hardcodes v2.1.79 but CDN returns 403. Affects all repos using @v1. Misleading 'installed successfully' message printed despite failure.

signals.topic: Default workflow template exposes secrets to unauthorized users on public repos
signals.summary: The default workflow template lacks author_association checks, allowing any user on public repos to trigger workflows that access secrets (API keys, OAuth tokens) and OIDC tokens. The job starts and secrets are passed to runner before any internal permission checks.
signals.review_reason: Critical security concern: secrets exposure on public repositories. Every public repo using the default template is affected. The gap between documented security (write-access-only) and actual behavior (anyone can trigger) is a significant risk.

source_issues.title: Default workflow template missing author trust gate — secrets exposed on public repos
source_issues.evidence: Template only checks for @claude mention, not author_association. Any user can trigger workflow that accesses secrets and OIDC tokens. Security docs claim 'only users with write access' but workflow starts regardless.

signals.topic: MCP channel notifications (Telegram) not delivered to Claude Code session
signals.summary: Inbound channel notifications from the official Telegram MCP plugin are never delivered to the Claude Code session. Outbound tool calls work correctly, but the notification path is broken, making real-time messaging use cases impossible.
signals.review_reason: Breaks real-time notification use case for MCP channels. Affects multiple platforms (macOS, Windows) with official plugin, indicating systemic issue in notification delivery path.

source_issues.title: Channel notifications from telegram plugin not delivered to session (v2.1.81)
source_issues.evidence: MCP channel notifications (notifications/claude/channel) sent by official telegram plugin never delivered. Outbound replies work - only inbound notification path broken.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Telegram channel plugin: inbound messages not forwarded as channel notifications (Windows)
source_issues.evidence: Same issue on Windows 11 - Telegram MCP server starts successfully and outbound replies work, but inbound channel notifications not forwarded.

signals.topic: Remote Control session status and permission visibility issues
signals.summary: Two related Remote Control issues: (1) Sessions always appear as 'Idle' in app even when waiting for user input, making it impossible to identify sessions needing attention. (2) Permission prompts on iOS only show ~100 characters of command with no way to expand, forcing blind approval.
signals.review_reason: Impacts Remote Control usability significantly: users can't identify which sessions need attention, and can't make informed security decisions about permissions on mobile.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Remote Control sessions always shown as "Idle" in app even when waiting for user input
source_issues.evidence: Remote Control sessions in 'Idle' group regardless of actual state. No way to distinguish sessions needing attention from truly idle ones.

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Remote Control: allow expanding permission prompts on iOS to see the full command before approving
source_issues.evidence: Permission prompts truncated to ~100 chars on iOS with no expand option. Users must approve commands without seeing full details - security/usability concern.

signals.topic: Desktop context loss from unflagged platform messages (Stop button, background tasks)
signals.summary: The Desktop client inserts platform-generated messages ('No response requested.' when pressing Stop, task notifications) without the isMeta:true flag, causing the model to lose context awareness and treat ongoing sessions as fresh starts, re-reading files and re-dispatching agents unnecessarily.
signals.review_reason: Direct workflow disruption: Stop button usage (common action) causes model to forget session context and restart work from scratch, wasting user time and tokens. Has repro label and detailed transcript evidence.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Desktop Code inserts platform-generated messages without isMeta flag, causing context loss and stray responses
source_issues.evidence: User reports context amnesia after pressing Stop - model re-reads files and re-dispatches exploration agents for a codebase it had been actively editing. Transcript evidence shows synthetic messages enter conversation without isMeta flag.

signals.topic: Rate limit errors blocking authentication after subscription type changes
signals.summary: Users switching from API Console PAYG credits to Claude Pro subscription encounter persistent 'API Error: Rate limit reached' on every session start, regardless of actual usage (dashboard shows low usage). Logout command also fails to resolve the issue.
signals.review_reason: Complete authentication failure blocks all usage of the product. Subscription migration is a critical path that should work seamlessly.

source_issues.title: API Error: Rate limit reached after switching from API credits to Pro subscription - cannot authenticate
source_issues.evidence: User completely blocked from using Claude Code after subscription change. Error occurs immediately at session start, making the product unusable.

signals.topic: MCP servers silently absent from /mcp when configured via mcp.json or settings.json
signals.summary: MCP servers configured in ~/.claude/mcp.json or via mcpServers key in settings.json do not appear in /mcp command output. No error message or warning is shown - servers are simply absent, making debugging extremely difficult.
signals.review_reason: Silent failure of MCP configuration discovery breaks core extensibility feature. Users waste time debugging why their MCP servers aren't working with no feedback.

source_issues.title: [BUG] MCP servers silently absent from /mcp when configured via mcp.json or settings.json — wrong config store
source_issues.evidence: MCP servers configured via documented methods are completely invisible in /mcp output with no error indication.

signals.topic: Usage quota transparency - No way to verify remaining usage or promotional multipliers
signals.summary: Users have no visibility into their actual usage quotas, remaining tokens in the 5-hour window, or whether promotional multipliers (like '2x usage promo') are actually active. This creates trust issues as users cannot verify they are receiving promised benefits.
signals.review_reason: Users are blocked from verifying if they receive the service they pay for. This affects trust and creates uncertainty about billing/quota. However, it's a single issue from one repo with no evidence of workflow blocking, so P2 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: User reports no counter, API endpoint, or UI indicator to verify actual remaining quota. Cannot distinguish between genuine 2x increase vs restoration of reduced limits. Multiple Reddit threads corroborate concerns.

signals.topic: Opus 4.6 quality degradation - Model takes shortcuts on complex reasoning tasks
signals.summary: Users report significant quality drops on Opus 4.6 for complex multi-step reasoning tasks. Model takes shortcuts, fabricates numbers instead of computing from formulas, and pattern-matches instead of solving problems properly.
signals.review_reason: This is a user-impacting quality issue where previously working tasks now fail. The model produces incorrect results on complex reasoning tasks, affecting user productivity and trust. Corroborated by multiple users on Reddit. Marked P1 due to clear workflow impact, though single repo/source.

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: User reports model makes up numbers instead of computing from formulas, pattern-matches to closest-looking answer instead of doing the math. Previously identical tasks were completed perfectly but now frequently fail. Multiple Reddit threads corroborate (r/ClaudeAI, r/ClaudeCode, r/Anthropic - March 17-20, 2026). Coincides with elevated errors/outages on Opus 4.6.

signals.topic: Telegram plugin: incoming messages not delivered to Claude Code
signals.summary: 用户配置好 Telegram bot 后，发送的消息无法传递到 Claude Code 会话。表现为：bot 收到消息（typing 指示器显示）、MCP 服务器运行、但消息静默丢失或从未出现在会话中。涉及多个根本原因：grammY 轮询问题、MCP 服务器崩溃、stdio 管道断裂等。
signals.review_reason: 高频问题(6个issue)，主流程完全阻断：用户配置 bot 后无法从 Telegram 与 Claude Code 通信。多个用户独立报告相同症状，有详细的诊断步骤确认问题在插件层而非用户配置错误。

source_issues.title: Inbound Telegram DMs silently dropped
source_issues.evidence: DM should have appeared as channel block, but nothing appeared. Bot did not reply. No error surfaced anywhere.

source_issues.title: Telegram Plugin: Bot receives messages but Claude Code never responds
source_issues.evidence: Messages sent to Telegram bot produce no response from Claude Code. Inbox stays empty, no response sent.

source_issues.title: Telegram MCP server process crashes repeatedly, incoming messages never delivered
source_issues.evidence: MCP server process dies silently during session. Bot can send but never receives incoming messages.

source_issues.title: Telegram channel plugin: grammY polling not consuming updates
source_issues.evidence: grammY's bot.start() polling never consumes updates from Telegram's getUpdates endpoint. Messages sit pending indefinitely.

source_issues.title: Configure OK, but bot never replies back
source_issues.evidence: Bot configuration went well, but pooling is not working even though user sees typing indicator.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: shell env var overrides .env token, causing silent 401
source_issues.evidence: Stale env var overrides correct .env token, causing 401 Unauthorized on every reply call. CLOSED - likely fixed.

signals.topic: Channel plugins ignore *_STATE_DIR environment variable
signals.summary: Discord/Telegram channel skills (access/configure) 和 server.ts 对 STATE_DIR 环境变量的处理不一致。skills 硬编码路径而 server 读取环境变量，导致配对流程在自定义状态目录时失败。
signals.review_reason: 影响多通道/项目隔离场景的用户：配对流程完全失败，用户无法完成 bot 配置。两个独立issue报告相同根因。

source_issues.title: Channel skills (access/configure) ignore *_STATE_DIR, breaking pairing when state dir is customized
source_issues.evidence: When *_STATE_DIR is set, server writes access.json to custom path but skill reads from default path. Pairing always fails because skill never finds pending entry.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin ignores TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR, breaking multi-channel setups
source_issues.evidence: STATE_DIR hardcoded on line 25 of server.ts. Access control, inbox, approvals all read/write from wrong directory when running multiple channels.

signals.topic: Telegram plugin: voice messages block all subsequent communication
signals.summary: 发送语音消息后，插件保存音频文件但不传递消息到 Claude Code，且所有后续文本消息也被阻止，需要手动终端干预才能恢复通信。
signals.review_reason: 单issue但用户影响严重：语音消息触发后完全阻断通信通道，需要终端干预。是明确的功能性阻断而非体验下降。

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: voice messages not delivered, blocks all subsequent messages
source_issues.evidence: Voice file saved to inbox but message never delivered to session. All subsequent messages including plain text also blocked. User gets no response and has to access terminal directly.

signals.topic: Discord/Telegram: plan mode and permission prompts stall remote channel
signals.summary: 当 Claude Code 进入计划模式或需要权限确认时，远程通道完全停滞——用户在聊天界面看不到提示也无法响应，必须走到终端前操作。
signals.review_reason: 核心UX阻碍：远程通道的核心价值（远程访问）被破坏。issue 明确指出这是 '#1 UX blocker for using channels as a truly remote interface'。

source_issues.title: Discord/Telegram: plan mode and permission prompts stall the channel — no way to respond from chat
source_issues.evidence: When Claude Code enters plan mode or hits permission prompt, it blocks in terminal waiting for input. Channel goes completely silent, remote user has no idea what happened and no way to respond.

signals.topic: skill-creator: improve_description.py requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, breaks Max plan users
signals.summary: skill-creator 插件的 improve_description.py 脚本直接调用 Anthropic SDK，需要 API key 并按 token 计费。Max 订阅用户没有 API key，导致工作流中断。
signals.review_reason: 特定付费用户群完全无法使用该功能：Max 订阅用户（无独立 API key）在 skill 创建流程中被阻断。

source_issues.title: skill-creator: improve_description.py uses Anthropic SDK directly, breaks Max plan users
source_issues.evidence: improve_description.py crashes with: TypeError: Could not resolve authentication method. Expected either api_key or auth_token to be set. Max plan users have no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

signals.topic: Skill discoverability and installation failures
signals.summary: Users cannot discover or install key skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, internal-comms) due to multiple compounding issues: hidden marketplace not added by default, non-intuitive bundle naming (document-skills instead of pdf), no in-CLI search capability, and installation failures with 'skill not found' errors.
signals.review_reason: Multiple users reporting inability to find and install skills they need. One user wasted hours doing manual work because skills were invisible. Another user completely blocked from installing a required skill. Affects core product discoverability.

source_issues.title: Document-skills (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) are nearly invisible to users — discoverability and naming problem

signals.topic: Config file corruption during skill-creator usage
signals.summary: The .claude.json configuration file gets corrupted due to race conditions in file writes, particularly when using skill-creator with high-frequency file system activity. Users lose authentication, projects data, tool usage history, and must go through new user onboarding again.
signals.review_reason: Direct user impact with data loss - users lose their authentication, settings, and must repeat onboarding. Happens repeatedly during normal skill-creator usage. Clear evidence of corruption patterns with backup files preserved.

source_issues.title: Skill Creator causes config file corruption
source_issues.evidence: User reports config corruption happens repeatedly across sessions, causing loss of authentication state, project settings, and requiring re-onboarding. Evidence shows non-atomic write paths racing with atomic writes, producing corrupted JSON with leftover bytes from previous file versions.

signals.topic: Windows platform encoding crashes in docx skill
signals.summary: The docx skill's validate.py and pack.py scripts crash on Windows with UnicodeEncodeError/UnicodeDecodeError because they rely on default system encoding (cp1252) instead of UTF-8. This blocks Windows users from using the docx skill pipeline.
signals.review_reason: Blocks Windows users from core docx skill functionality. Requires workarounds that most users won't know about. Affects main workflow (validation and packing of docx files).

source_issues.title: [Bug] docx skill: validate.py and pack.py crash on Windows due to missing UTF-8 encoding in file I/O and print output

signals.topic: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
signals.summary: User-installed skills have no mechanism to override or modify system skill behavior. When a user skill contains a behavioral rule that conflicts with a system skill, the system skill always wins. Users install custom skills specifically to customize behavior but cannot do so.
signals.review_reason: Limits user customization capability - users install skills to modify behavior but those modifications are ignored. Not a crash, but causes confusion and prevents desired workflows. No documented priority system exists.

source_issues.title: User skills cannot override system skill behavior
source_issues.evidence: User has a custom skill to deliver files via MCP server instead of present_files. Claude reads the user skill but follows the system skill's pipeline instead. The model itself identified that system skill's specific instructions override user skill's general rules.

signals.summary: Tool execution spans (FinalAnswerTool, MCPAdaptTool, SimpleTool) appear as root spans instead of being nested under the corresponding step chain, breaking observability tool integration with Phoenix and other OTLP backends
signals.review_reason: Significant user impact for production monitoring: observability tools like Phoenix cannot properly trace agent execution flow. Tool spans appearing as root spans makes debugging multi-step agent workflows unreliable. A regression from previous working behavior.

source_issues.title: BUG: Missing parent id for OpenTelemetry tool spans when using CodeAgent
source_issues.evidence: User provided screenshots and reproducible code showing tool spans incorrectly appearing as root spans in Phoenix observability tool. Previously worked correctly; now broken. ToolCallingAgent still works correctly, only CodeAgent affected.

signals.topic: Tokenizer.encode crashes when prepend is a string token
signals.summary: When using Tokenizer.encode() with prepend parameter as a string (e.g., BOS token), the code raises NameError/ValueError due to scope issue and encode_single_token() failure for multi-token strings
signals.review_reason: 实际代码bug，阻断用户使用prepend功能的tokenization流程，导致运行时崩溃

source_issues.title: [Bug] Tokenizer.encode: prepend_id scope issue causes NameError when prepend is string
source_issues.evidence: prepend_id variable may be referenced before being defined; encode_single_token() raises ValueError if string is not valid single token, making it impossible to prepend multi-token sequences

signals.topic: analysis.ipynb notebook crashes with UnboundLocalError
signals.summary: The analysis notebook has a variable scope bug where 'best' is used in Progress Plot cell but 'best_bpb' is defined later in Summary stats cell, causing sequential execution to fail
signals.review_reason: 阻断用户运行分析notebook的核心功能，无法正常查看实验进度图表

signals.topic: Autoresearch experiments all rejected - 0% keep rate
signals.summary: Nightly autoresearch runs produce 0 kept experiments out of 400-560 attempts because gemma3:1b draft model generates code that Gemini reviewer consistently rejects
signals.review_reason: 主流程完全阻断 - 自动研究循环产出为0，用户无法获得任何有效的实验结果，核心功能不可用

source_issues.title: fix: 0/N experiments kept — upgrade draft model + tighter task scope
source_issues.evidence: 3+ nights with 0 experiments kept out of 400-560 attempts; rejection reasons include incomplete changes, not following style guidelines, incomplete agent workflow descriptions

signals.topic: DaytonaSandbox backend read() hangs indefinitely with custom snapshot images
signals.summary: When using deepagents DaytonaSandbox backend with a custom daytona snapshot derived from daytonaio/sandbox:latest-slim, the read() method hangs indefinitely until manually interrupted. This blocks agent workflows that need to read files from sandbox environments.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：使用自定义snapshot时read()方法无限挂起，直接影响agent对sandbox文件系统的访问，阻断正常工作流。用户提供了完整的复现步骤和堆栈跟踪，确认是回归问题（v0.0.3正常，v0.0.4出问题）。

source_issues.title: DaytonaSandbox hangs on read() using custom snapshot image
source_issues.evidence: User reports program hangs indefinitely when calling backend.read('/etc/os-release') with custom snapshot. Stack trace shows the hang occurs in _execute_via_session_logs. Problem confirmed with langchain-daytona v0.0.4 but not v0.0.3.

signals.topic: Subagent streaming data incomplete in React useStream hook
signals.summary: When using Python deepagents with React useStream, subagent streaming is incomplete on the client side. stream.subagents and stream.activeSubagents stay empty despite streamSubgraphs being enabled. Only getSubagentsByMessage() briefly contains data during streaming, which disappears after session settles.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：文档明确承诺的subagent streaming功能在实际使用中无法正常工作，导致前端无法依赖原生API渲染子代理状态。用户提供了完整的复现代码和详细的环境信息，11条评论显示该问题受到持续关注。

source_issues.title: Python deepagents subagent streaming data is incomplete in React useStream: stream.subagents stays empty while getSubagentsByMessage has data
source_issues.evidence: User provides detailed reproduction showing stream.subagents and stream.activeSubagents remain empty. Documentation promises stable subagent state but actual behavior differs significantly. Frontend must reconstruct subagents from tool calls/results as fallback.

signals.topic: Skills directory parameter not recognized by create_deep_agent
signals.summary: When passing skills=['./skills/'] to create_deep_agent, the skills directory is not recognized in the agent's system prompt. Users cannot configure skill directories as documented, blocking the skills feature entirely.
signals.review_reason: 功能不可用：按文档配置skills目录后功能仍无法工作，阻断用户使用skills功能。问题已关闭可能有修复，但作为用户痛点记录。count<3且单仓库，故降为P2。

source_issues.title: create_deep_agent(skills=["./skills/"]) unable to recognize skills directory
source_issues.evidence: User provides code showing skills path configuration with FilesystemBackend but agent prompt does not include skills. Screenshot evidence shows the skills directory exists but is not loaded into agent context.

signals.topic: Large tool result eviction causes storage bloat
signals.summary: Large tool results evicted to filesystem accumulate indefinitely in /large_tool_results/ directory without cleanup mechanism. Long-running agents or high-volume tool usage consume excessive disk space.
signals.review_reason: 资源管理问题影响长期运行：缺少清理机制导致磁盘空间持续增长，对长时间运行的agent造成实际影响。虽然问题已关闭（可能已修复），但作为真实用户痛点记录。

source_issues.title: SDK: Storage bloat from large tool result eviction
source_issues.evidence: Issue clearly describes the problem: evicted tool results accumulate indefinitely leading to storage bloat. No cleanup mechanism exists.

signals.topic: Character-counting truncation causes context overflow or waste
signals.summary: Current truncation logic uses brittle character-count heuristics instead of actual token counting. This often results in either context overflows (crashes) or overly aggressive truncation that wastes available context space, degrading agent response quality.
signals.review_reason: 影响结果质量：不精确的截断可能导致上下文溢出（崩溃）或过度截断（浪费token成本），两者都对用户体验有负面影响。虽已关闭但记录为真实痛点。

source_issues.title: SDK: Replace brittle character-counting truncation with robust token counting
source_issues.evidence: Issue describes that character-count heuristics are brittle and cause either context overflows or overly aggressive truncation, wasting context space.

signals.topic: OpenAI/Azure Integration: Tool Calling Failures with Thinking Models, Server Tools, and Streaming
signals.summary: Multiple critical bugs in langchain-openai integration causing tool calling to fail: (1) tool_choice='required' breaks thinking models like qwen3.5-plus and deepseek-r1 with 400 errors, (2) UnboundLocalError crashes when using unrecognized server tool names (e.g., 'computer'), (3) Streaming drops 'namespace' field from deferred function_call blocks causing round-trip 400 errors.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency (3 issues) critical bugs that completely break agent tool calling workflows. Users cannot use thinking models, new server tools, or streaming with deferred tools - all are core LangChain use cases with clear API errors (400, UnboundLocalError) blocking production usage.

source_issues.title: openai model: tool_choice="required" not compatible with thinking models (qwen3.5-plus)
source_issues.evidence: User reports 400 errors when using thinking models (qwen3.5-plus, deepseek-r1) with LangChain agents because tool_choice='required' is forced, but thinking models only support 'auto' or 'none'

source_issues.title: langchain-openai: _consolidate_calls raises UnboundLocalError for unrecognized server tool names
source_issues.evidence: Code crashes with UnboundLocalError when using server tools with unrecognized names like 'computer' or 'image_generation' - variable 'collapsed' is never assigned

source_issues.title: bug(openai): Streaming drops `namespace` from deferred `function_call` content blocks, causing 400 "Missing namespace" on round-trip
source_issues.evidence: Streaming with tool_search + defer_loading silently drops namespace field, causing OpenAI to reject subsequent requests with 400 'Missing namespace for function_call'

signals.topic: Dependency Version Conflicts: langchain-together Incompatible with v1 langchain-openai
signals.summary: Package dependency resolution fails when trying to use langchain-together with v1 versions of langchain-openai and other langchain packages. Users cannot install or update their projects due to unsatisfiable dependency requirements.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users from installing or updating LangChain packages when using Together AI integration. Dependency resolution failures prevent any project progress, though it's a single issue and may be ecosystem-specific.

source_issues.title: langchain-together breaks with v1 versions of langchain-openai and so on
source_issues.evidence: User cannot run 'uv sync --all-packages' due to dependency conflict: langchain-together<=0.3.1 is available but project requires langchain-together>=1.0, making requirements unsatisfiable

signals.topic: Performance Regression: HuggingFaceEmbeddings Excessive Device-to-CPU Transfers
signals.summary: HuggingFaceEmbeddings is ~1.84x slower than calling sentence_transformers directly due to unnecessary device-to-CPU memory transfers per batch (32 synchronizations instead of 1 for 1000 texts). Also Chroma.from_texts recomputes embeddings per storage batch instead of once.
signals.review_reason: Significant performance degradation (~1.84x slower) affects users doing batch embeddings with HuggingFace models on MPS/CUDA devices. Impacts production workloads with large document corpora, though it's a performance optimization rather than a complete blockage.

source_issues.title: perf: HuggingFaceEmbeddings causes excessive device-to-cpu transfers per batch
source_issues.evidence: Benchmark shows 1.157s vs 0.631s (1.84x slower). Each .cpu() call flushes hardware command buffer - a full synchronization point. For 1000 texts at batch_size=32, this means 32 synchronizations instead of 1, adding ~640ms overhead

signals.topic: Callback Tracing Regression: RunnableWithFallbacks Drops parent_run_id for Child Events
signals.summary: Regression from PR #25550 causes RunnableWithFallbacks.invoke() to drop parent_run_id for child callback events. This breaks tracing/observability tools that rely on parent_run_id to build span trees - child LLM spans become orphans invisible to traces.
signals.review_reason: Regression that breaks observability/tracing tools - a critical production use case. Users relying on LangSmith or custom callbacks lose visibility into fallback chain execution. Fix is identified as one-line change.

source_issues.title: RunnableWithFallbacks.invoke() drops parent_run_id for child callback events (regression from #25550)
source_issues.evidence: Code analysis shows config is passed instead of child_config on line 196, causing parent_run_id=None in child callbacks. This breaks any tracing/observability tool relying on parent_run_id for span trees

signals.topic: Checkpoint state persistence inconsistency
signals.summary: Users experience data loss or resurrection of deleted threads due to checkpoint timing issues. When a run is cancelled, streamed state not yet persisted is lost. When a thread is deleted, late checkpoint writes can resurrect deleted data, breaking retention and audit workflows.
signals.review_reason: Direct user impact: data loss on cancellation and data corruption on deletion are production-blocking issues affecting data integrity and audit compliance. Both issues demonstrate real user pain with state management in production deployments.

source_issues.title: Run Cancellation Causes Loss of Streamed State Not Yet Persisted as a Checkpoint
source_issues.evidence: User reports that after cancel_run(), streamed data between last persisted checkpoint and cancel is lost, causing data integrity issues in production workflows.

source_issues.title: Prevent late checkpoint writes from resurrecting deleted threads
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates that delete_thread() does not block late put/put_writes calls, allowing delayed writers to repopulate state for deleted threads, breaking audit workflows.

signals.topic: Background runs re-executed after 180s timeout
signals.summary: Long-running background runs (>3 minutes) are incorrectly re-executed after ~181 seconds, causing duplicate work and wasted API costs. The BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS environment variable does not prevent this behavior.
signals.review_reason: Clear production impact: user reports wasted API costs due to duplicate work on LangGraph Cloud. The issue has a documented reproduction case and affects any user with long-running nodes, making it a significant cost and reliability concern.

source_issues.title: Background runs re-executed after ~180s despite BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS being set higher
source_issues.evidence: Production user on LangGraph Cloud reports that nodes taking 3-7 minutes cause duplicate execution after exactly ~181s, resulting in doubled API costs. Tried multiple workarounds (BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS=900, BG_JOB_ISOLATED_LOOPS=true) with no effect.

signals.topic: ToolNode error messages lack model output metadata
signals.summary: When a tool call fails (e.g., due to max_tokens truncation), the ToolNode only returns the exception text without the model's response_metadata. This prevents models from understanding why their output failed, leading to endless retry loops (user reported 249 retries).
signals.review_reason: High-impact user pain: 249 retry loops represent significant wasted tokens and costs. The issue prevents autonomous agents from self-correcting, a core LangGraph use case. User provides concrete reproduction with max_tokens truncation scenario.

source_issues.title: ToolNode: surface model output metadata in tool error messages to enable self-correction
source_issues.evidence: User's autonomous agent retried a failed tool call 249 times because the error message lacked context about max_tokens truncation. The model received 'content: Field required' error but had no way to know its JSON was truncated mid-argument.

signals.topic: langgraph dev startup failure with ModuleNotFoundError
signals.summary: The langgraph dev command fails on startup with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named langgraph_executor' in langgraph-api 0.7.35 Docker image. The module is imported but does not exist in the published image, preventing applications from starting.
signals.review_reason: Critical blocking issue: users cannot start their development environment at all. This is a packaging/release regression that completely blocks the main development workflow. User provided docker verification commands proving the module is missing from the published image.

source_issues.title: langgraph dev: ModuleNotFoundError for langgraph_executor in langgraph-api 0.7.35 Docker image
source_issues.evidence: User verified the missing module by running docker exec command showing ModuleNotFoundError. The queue entrypoint crashes in a loop, completely preventing the application from starting.

signals.topic: StructuredTool.invoke() requires ToolRuntime for standalone calls
signals.summary: Users cannot call .invoke() on a StructuredTool standalone (e.g., for unit testing) because it requires a ToolRuntime object. Neither Optional[ToolRuntime] nor passing None works due to Pydantic validation errors.
signals.review_reason: Blocks unit testing of tools, a common developer workflow. While not production-blocking, it significantly impacts developer experience and testing practices. Workaround is unclear from the issue.

source_issues.title: Calling .invoke() as standalone on a StructuredTool requires a ToolRuntime object
source_issues.evidence: User trying to unit test tool functions cannot invoke them standalone. With ToolRuntime parameter, Pydantic says 'runtime input is missing'. With Optional[ToolRuntime] and None, Pydantic says 'tool input parameters need to be JSON serializable'.

signals.topic: Plugin Daemon Service 500 error causes workflow failures on Cloud
signals.summary: Users report sudden 500 errors from Plugin Daemon Service on Dify Cloud, breaking workflows that were previously working without any configuration changes. This is a critical service availability issue affecting production workflows.
signals.review_reason: Two distinct reports of Plugin Daemon failures causing complete workflow breakdown and plugin install failures. This is a critical production blocker affecting Cloud users with no workaround.

source_issues.title: Sudden error without changes "Request to Plugin Daemon Service failed-500" (DIFY CLOUD 1.13.2)
source_issues.evidence: Workflow using AWS Bedrock Claude Sonnet 3.7 fails after 10 minutes with 'Request to Plugin Daemon Service failed-500'. It was working without errors until 08:54 CET, broke somewhere between 09:00-10:00 without any changes.

source_issues.title: Plugins install and update error on version 1.13.2
source_issues.evidence: Cannot install new plugins and update new version on 1.13.x - error occurred during plugin operations.

signals.topic: pnpm build fails with pnpm-lock.yaml conflict and vinext dependency resolution
signals.summary: Self-hosted users building from source encounter failures: 1) pnpm-lock.yaml in user home folder causes build failures, 2) vinext@18fe3ea dependency fails to download from pkg.pr.new due to ECONNRESET.
signals.review_reason: Blocks self-hosted users from building and deploying. The commit-hash versioned dependency (vinext@18fe3ea) from pkg.pr.new is unstable and causes network failures.

source_issues.title: Unable to start web service after `pnpm build` with suspicous pnpm lockfile
source_issues.evidence: pnpm build succeeds but pnpm start fails with 'Cannot find module .next/standalone/server.js'. Caused by pnpm-lock.yaml in user home folder.

source_issues.title: pnpm cannot install vinext@18fe3ea in web, what is vinext@18fe3ea
source_issues.evidence: vinext@18fe3ea fails to install with 'FetchError: request to https://pkg.pr.new/vinext@18Bfe3ea failed, reason: read ECONNRESET'. Users question what this commit-hash versioned dependency is.

signals.topic: Streaming workflow response missing message_end and knowledge base metadata
signals.summary: After upgrading from v0.15.3 to v1.30.0, streaming API responses no longer include the message_end event and knowledge base attribution metadata (document names, segment content), breaking applications that rely on this data for source verification.
signals.review_reason: Regression from upgrade that breaks API integrations relying on streaming response metadata. Users cannot verify answer sources or maintain content transparency.

source_issues.title: Streaming workflow response missing message_end and knowledge base attribution metadata in v1.30.0 (worked in v0.15.3)
source_issues.evidence: In v0.15.3, API response included flag with retrieved knowledge base name/ID, document name, and segment content. After upgrading to v1.30.0, even with 'Show attribution documents and content' enabled, API no longer returns message_end or knowledge base metadata.

signals.topic: File upload fails after upgrade to 1.13.x with OpenSearch ImportError
signals.summary: After upgrading from 1.12.0 to 1.13.2, file uploads fail with ImportError due to module conflict between Dify's internal events module and opensearchpy's events dependency.
signals.review_reason: Critical upgrade blocker that completely prevents file uploads for users with OpenSearch vector DB. The module name collision is a clear regression affecting the core knowledge base functionality.

source_issues.title: Files Fail to Be Uploaded After the Version Is Upgraded from 1.12.0 to 1.13.2
source_issues.evidence: ImportError: cannot import name 'Events' from 'events' (/app/api/events/__init__.py) - opensearchpy tries to import 'events' but resolves to Dify's internal events module instead of its own dependency.

signals.topic: Frontend stop button fails to terminate local model inference, causing GPU exhaustion
signals.summary: When using local models that enter infinite generation loops, clicking the Stop button on the frontend does not terminate the backend inference process. The model continues generating tokens indefinitely, causing GPU memory to remain at 98-99% utilization.
signals.review_reason: Critical stability issue for local model deployment. Resource exhaustion can crash the entire system. Users have no way to recover GPU resources without manual intervention.

source_issues.title: Frontend interrupt cannot stop local model infinite generation loop, model keeps outputting and occupying GPU memory
source_issues.evidence: After clicking Stop generating on frontend, backend model still keeps generating tokens (logs show continuous output). GPU memory usage reaches 98%-99% and remains high. nvidia-smi shows all RTX 6000D GPUs stuck at 98-99% memory.

signals.topic: Qdrant本地存储重启时默认删除所有数据
signals.summary: 使用Qdrant本地path存储时，如果未显式设置on_disk=True，每次程序重启都会静默删除所有持久化数据，导致用户记忆完全丢失
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：数据完全丢失是核心功能失效，用户记忆永久性消失，无任何警告。count=1但有强用户影响证据（数据丢失+可复现步骤+核心功能影响），符合P0例外条件。

source_issues.title: Bug Report: Qdrant Local Storage Loses Data on Restart Due to `on_disk` Default
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：使用Qdrant本地path存储时，on_disk默认为False导致shutil.rmtree()被调用，每次Memory.from_config()初始化时静默删除整个存储目录。复现步骤显示第二次运行时所有数据丢失。

signals.topic: Qdrant scoped JWT认证导致所有写操作失败
signals.summary: 使用Qdrant collection-scoped JWT时，ensureCollection只捕获409冲突，不捕获401/403，导致每次写操作都抛出异常，服务完全不可用
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：使用scoped JWT的用户完全无法写入数据，是auth权限处理缺陷导致的阻断性问题。影响生产环境中使用最小权限JWT配置的用户。

source_issues.title: ensureCollection throws 403 with Qdrant scoped JWTs — only catches 409, not 401/403
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：PR #4297引入的回归问题，使用scoped JWT时createCollection返回401/403但未被捕获，每次mem.add()都抛出异常。提供了完整复现代码和错误信息。

signals.topic: Valkey update()调用导致embedding损坏
signals.summary: 当内存内容未变化时调用update(vector=None)，Valkey后端无条件序列化None为4字节标量，覆盖原有embedding，导致记忆永久不可搜索
signals.review_reason: 静默数据损坏：用户不知情的情况下embedding被破坏，记忆内容存在但永远无法被搜索到。这是数据完整性问题，影响使用Valkey后端的用户。

source_issues.title: Mem0 with Valkey: update() corrupts embeddings when called with vector=None
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：np.array(None, dtype=np.float32)产生4字节标量覆盖正确的4096字节embedding，维度不匹配导致向量搜索完全失效。提供了详细的代码分析和复现步骤。

signals.topic: GoogleLLM忽略tools参数导致graph memory无实体提取
signals.summary: GoogleLLM.generateResponse不传递tools参数给Gemini API，导致graph memory功能完全失效，Neo4j中无任何实体被提取，无错误提示
signals.review_reason: 关键功能静默失败：用户配置了graph memory功能但完全无效，无任何错误提示。影响使用Google/Gemini provider的用户无法使用graph memory核心功能。

source_issues.title: GoogleLLM.generateResponse ignores tools parameter — graph memory silently produces no entities with Google/Gemini provider
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：使用Google/Gemini作为LLM provider时，enableGraph=true配置下Neo4j始终为空，零实体被提取。问题原因是tools参数未传递给generateContent API。

signals.topic: Qdrant集合默认使用错误维度(1536而非实际embedding维度)

signals.review_reason: 配置陷阱导致功能失败：默认值假设所有用户使用OpenAI，使用其他embedding模型的用户遇到维度不匹配问题。属于默认值设计缺陷影响核心向量存储功能。

source_issues.title: Qdrant collection created with wrong vector dimensions — mem0 defaults to 1536 (OpenAI's embedding size)
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：使用nomic-embed-text(768维)时集合被创建为1536维，导致向量操作失败。需要手动在配置中显式设置embedding_model_dims: 768。

signals.topic: API调用失败导致主流程阻断 (HTTP 400/InvalidDataException)

signals.topic: VSCode Test Explorer fails to discover tests
signals.summary: Multiple reports of VSCode Playwright extension failing to show tests in Test Explorer. Issues include tests disappearing after browser reinstall and tests not being found when package.json has 'type: module'.

source_issues.title: [BUG] When starting Playwright I never see my testcases in test explorer

signals.topic: Playwright process hangs randomly and does not exit after tests complete
signals.summary: In CI environments, chrome-headless-shell occasionally doesn't exit after Playwright sends Browser.close via CDP. The worker's fixture teardown blocks waiting forever for the process close event, causing CI steps to timeout. User reports 30-100 occurrences per day across thousands of CI runs.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency CI failure causing significant productivity loss. User provides detailed instrumentation evidence and even a workaround patch. This directly blocks CI workflows and causes daily disruptions in production environments.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Playwright randomly not exitting
source_issues.evidence: User reports: 'We are running 10 parallel workers across a few thousand CI runs a day and generally see this between 30-100 times a day.' The issue causes CI steps to timeout because the process never exits after test completion.

signals.topic: HTML reporter does not open when running tests in JetBrains IDEs
signals.summary: Starting from Playwright v1.57, the HTML reporter no longer opens automatically when running tests through WebStorm/IntelliJ test runners due to TTY detection changes. This is a regression affecting JetBrains IDE users.
signals.review_reason: Regression in a widely-used feature (HTML reporter) affecting a major IDE ecosystem (JetBrains). Users cannot view test reports after running tests, which is a core part of the test development workflow.

source_issues.title: [Regression]: HTML reporter does not open anymore after executing test through WebStorm/Intellij test runner
source_issues.evidence: User identified the regression started from v1.57 caused by PR #38044. HTML reporter fails to open when running tests through JetBrains IDEs, breaking the expected workflow.

signals.topic: headless_shell ignores --remote-debugging-address flag
signals.summary: When using headless mode with chromium, the --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0 flag is silently ignored and CDP always binds to 127.0.0.1. This prevents remote debugging from host machine in Docker environments.
signals.review_reason: Blocks remote debugging workflow in containerized environments (Docker). This is a common deployment pattern for CI and development, and the flag being silently ignored causes confusing failures.

source_issues.title: headless_shell ignores --remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0, always binds CDP to 127.0.0.1
source_issues.evidence: User cannot connect Chrome DevTools from host machine via chrome://inspect when running Playwright in Docker. Port mapping forwards traffic but headless_shell only binds to localhost, causing connection refused.

signals.topic: WebKit browser does not support WebGPU
signals.summary: Playwright's WebKit browser does not expose WebGPU even when the host system supports it. Stock Safari on the same machine has WebGPU support, but Playwright's WebKit shows 'webgpu is not available'.
signals.review_reason: Blocks users who need to test WebGPU functionality in WebKit. Creates inconsistency with native Safari behavior, affecting cross-browser testing completeness.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: WebGPU support in WebKit
source_issues.evidence: User tested on macOS where stock Safari 26.3.1 supports WebGPU, but Playwright's WebKit returns hasGpu: false. Blocks testing of WebGPU-dependent features.

signals.topic: Npgsql version incompatibility causes runtime crash with PgVector connector

signals.review_reason: Real user reports runtime crash when using PgVector connector with newer Npgsql version, blocking their ability to combine EF with SK vector functionality. This is a dependency conflict that prevents main flow execution.

signals.topic: config.cost override applies same rate to input and output token pricing

signals.review_reason: Direct financial impact on users - cost tracking feature produces incorrect results up to 4x error. Users relying on cost reports for budget decisions are misinformed.

source_issues.title: bug: config.cost override applies identical rate to both input and output token pricing

signals.review_reason: Silent failure - users configure settings that appear valid but are completely ignored. Workaround exists (azure:responses with isReasoningModel: true), but confusing for users following Azure's recommended OpenAI SDK migration path.
