signals.topic: MCP server startup failures and tool configuration errors
signals.summary: MCP相关功能存在多个阻断性问题：(1) 服务器启动时自毁（SIGKILL发送到自身PID）；(2) memory_store工具调用失败；(3) hive-mind spawn使用错误的MCP工具前缀(mcp__claude-flow__而非mcp__ruflo__)导致工具调用404
signals.review_reason: MCP是核心集成方式，这些bug导致：服务器无法启动、工具调用失败、spawn的agent使用不存在的工具名。虽然部分有workaround，但主流程受影响明显。

source_issues.title: MCP server self-kills on startup (SIGKILL to own PID)
source_issues.evidence: npx ruflo@latest mcp start crashes immediately. getStatus() detects stdio transport and returns current process PID, then start command does process.kill(existingStatus.pid, 'SIGKILL'), sending SIGKILL to its own PID.

source_issues.title: memory_store MCP tool fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined'
source_issues.evidence: ruflo mcp exec --tool memory_store returns error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length'). CLI workaround exists but MCP tool is broken.

source_issues.title: hive-mind spawn --claude prompt hardcodes wrong MCP tool prefix
source_issues.evidence: generateHiveMindPrompt() hardcodes 25 MCP tool references using mcp__claude-flow__ prefix. When Claude Code registers the ruflo MCP server, tools are exposed as mcp__ruflo__*. Spawned agents receive a prompt telling them to use tools that don't exist.

signals.topic: Swarm/Hive-mind agents fail to execute tasks (no execution engine + workers hang)
signals.summary: Swarm和Hive-mind的核心功能失败：agents被创建但从不执行任务。原因包括：(1) 没有执行引擎，MCP工具只做JSON CRUD但不spawn Claude进程；(2) headless worker由于stdin pipe未关闭而永久挂起，导致进程累积最终引发kernel panic
signals.review_reason: 核心功能完全阻断：用户创建swarm/hive-mind后agents不执行任何任务，且worker进程挂起可导致系统崩溃。这是主流程失败，有明确的用户影响证据（kernel panic、进程挂起）。

source_issues.title: Swarm agents still do not execute work — v3.5.42 (@claude-flow/cli@latest)
source_issues.evidence: agents never execute the assigned work. The fundamental issue is that no execution engine exists: MCP tools perform JSON CRUD on registry files, but nothing spawns a Claude subprocess to read the task description and act on it.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Workers always fail (stdin never closed) + daemons never terminate = kernel panic at scale
source_issues.evidence: Every headless worker invocation fails. On a 36 GB Mac with 8 Ruflo-enabled projects, this produced 9 hung claude --print processes at ~3 GB each + 8 daemon processes, totalling 71 GB RSS and a kernel panic.

signals.topic: Hive-mind worker status tracking non-functional (always shows idle/0 completed)
signals.summary: Hive-mind状态追踪系统完全失效：task_assign不会更新agent状态，task_complete不会增加taskCount，hive-mind_status返回硬编码的idle状态而非实际数据。用户无法监控任务进度或agent健康状态。
signals.review_reason: 核心监控功能失败：用户无法通过官方接口查看任务执行状态，所有worker永远显示idle。虽然任务可能实际在执行（如果其他bug已修复），但状态可见性完全丧失，是明显的用户体验降级。

source_issues.title: Hive-mind worker tracking is non-functional: task lifecycle never syncs agent state
source_issues.evidence: task_assign writes agent IDs to tasks/store.json but never updates agents.json → workers stay idle forever. hive-mind_status reports queen.load as 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4 — a random number, not derived from actual task state.

source_issues.title: v3 regression: hive-mind_status hardcodes all workers as idle (status:'idle', tasksCompleted:0)
source_issues.evidence: hive-mind_status always reports all workers as idle with tasksCompleted: 0, regardless of actual agent state. This is a v3 regression. workers: state.workers.map(w => ({ status: 'idle', currentTask: null, tasksCompleted: 0 })) — HARDCODED.

signals.topic: Intelligence vector store loads only 1 pattern instead of 1,300+
signals.summary: 智能层(intelligence.cjs)的loadEntries()函数只识别object wrapper格式的存储文件，但auto-memory-hook.mjs写入的是flat array格式，导致只加载1个fallback pattern而非1300+条目，严重影响context检索和route hook的pattern matching效果
signals.review_reason: 智能路由功能严重降级：只加载1/1300的模式数据，导致context检索和pattern matching几乎无效。虽然不会崩溃，但核心AI功能大幅降级。

source_issues.title: fix: intelligence vector store loads only 1 pattern instead of 1,300+
source_issues.evidence: auto-memory-hook.mjs writes auto-memory-store.json as a flat JSON array, but intelligence.cjs loadEntries() only checked for object wrapper format. session-restore hook reports 'Loaded 1 patterns' instead of 1,300+. Intelligence-based routing has no data to work with.
